source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Run MLPerf Inference v4.0 Stable Diffusion XL Offline and compare with MLCommons v4.0.
procedure_facts: The SDXL Offline RUN_ARGS quote is unclosed.
The criteria text incorrectly asks for valid BERT performance.
criteria_facts: Greater than an unspecified official NVIDIA MLPerf score.
source_conflicts: SDXL conflicts with BERT validation text.
The run command is syntactically incomplete.
The score reference does not identify a comparable SDXL Offline system.
missing_source_information: Pinned v4.0 SDXL model/components, COCO data/preprocessing and harness.
Image-quality, LoadGen/compliance and comparable samples/s rules.

original_test_intent.statement: Run MLPerf Inference v4.0 Stable Diffusion XL Offline, prove release-specific image-quality and LoadGen/compliance validity, measure Offline samples/s, and compare with a signed comparable result.
must_preserve: GPU-intensive whole-system run and comparable reference.
must_not_infer: BERT, Server or another image model/release.
That the broken command is executable.
Official status or comparability from a headline score.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 detects the unclosed quote and BERT mismatch and requires licensed SDXL artifacts plus image-quality/LoadGen validity.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not require component-level model/preprocessing identity or an explicit SDXL image-quality metric/result ID before comparing Offline throughput.

related_records: Language and recommendation benchmarks cannot supply SDXL image-quality or preprocessing evidence.
applicable_history.precedence_application: SDXL Offline intent is clear, but command and BERT/acceptance defects require formal rewrite.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Rewrite the malformed command and BERT criterion around a pinned SDXL Offline v4.0 implementation, image-quality rule and comparable result before execution.

conditions_present: Title and benchmark argument identify SDXL Offline.
missing: Correct command, component/artifact hashes/licenses, quality/compliance workflow, comparable result, thresholds and load limits.
provider: Benchmark owner rewrites the command and acceptance.
Data/software owners supply model components and dataset.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory GPU/topology/runtime/storage and inspect artifact/result metadata and licenses.
prohibited_until_resolved: Execute malformed command, substitute BERT, download artifacts, tune/run, clear logs or PASS.
closure_evidence: Comparable Offline result ID and numeric quality/performance rule.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v4.0 Stable Diffusion XL Offline
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v4.0 Stable Diffusion XL Offline configuration, verify required image-quality plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure Offline samples per second, and compare only with a signed comparable v4.0 SDXL result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact SUT/GPU topology, driver/runtime, container/harness commit, SDXL component weights, approved COCO data/preprocessing and v4.0 configs. Model variants, schedulers and preprocessing are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All resources declared by the system configuration; Stable Diffusion XL; Offline only. BERT, Server and other diffusion models/releases are excluded.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Corrected checksummed command; pinned v4.0 implementation; licensed SDXL components/data and preprocessing hashes; system/user/mlperf configs; image-quality, PerformanceOnly and compliance procedures; random-seed policy; approved tuning/power/cooling; comparable result ID; quality, samples/s, validity and health thresholds.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify all component/config hashes and baseline health, then run SDXL image-quality, Offline performance and required compliance phases exactly as the pinned v4.0 implementation specifies. Preserve LoadGen logs, quality outputs and telemetry. Never execute the open-quote command or BERT check.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Formal rewrite complete; artifacts licensed/pinned; all GPUs healthy; adequate storage/memory/cooling/power; tuning, output retention and recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/GPU identity; driver/runtime/container/harness and each model/data/preprocessing hash; configs/seed/exact commands; SDXL image-quality result; complete LoadGen logs and valid Offline samples/s; required compliance; retained output manifest where policy permits; XID/ECC/power/thermal/host logs; named comparable result and normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v4.0 SDXL Offline quality and LoadGen rules plus the identified comparable result. Pass requires quality validity, valid performance/compliance, samples/s comparison and clean platform health. BERT validity or command exit is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix models/scenarios/releases, use unlicensed artifacts, change component/preprocessing/seed/tuning without approval, retain restricted images improperly, suppress invalidity, clear logs or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/software/platform owners approve artifacts, quality/reference, tuning, retention and load; a human judges final disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans correct command/criterion and decide comparability. The Agent runs only the pinned SDXL workflow after gates.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity or limits, preserve permitted evidence, terminate cleanly, restore tuning/services and verify GPU/host health before an approved rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Malformed/wrong-model command; missing license/config/reference; wrong scenario/release; quality/LoadGen/compliance failure; topology drift; XID/ECC/thermal/power/storage/host limit; evidence/monitoring loss.

identified_defects: No SDXL image-quality rule or comparable result identity.
reason_for_change: SDXL completion requires model-specific image-quality evidence; a broken command and BERT criterion cannot be repaired by copying another MLPerf case.

new_technical_evidence.supports: SDXL is a distinct text-to-image benchmark using COCO-derived data and requires release/model-specific artifacts.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact implementation and quality threshold are absent.
